notes.title: Patch 1.000: Release
notes.notes:
Hey guys,
here is a final EA update. It was ready for more than a year but had to postpone due to war.

This is not the last update for this game. Just a milestone to move forward.
This game probably will not get more content updates - just fixes and QoL updates.

You can reach me at my discord anytime: https://discord.gg/j5e7fYd

notes.title: Royal Booty Quest - Release Date
notes.notes:
Hey guys,
I have set the goal of releasing RBQ in October.
Now we working on an extra Hero with own deck.
For Release date - all features will be finished, two new heroes will be added - so it will be 8 in total.

Coop and Forge for items - are still in development, and they are probably not gonna be ready for those dates.

Also, there a couple more heroes who were frozen in the early stages of the development - I'll work on them after Release.

Expect new updates, new content, new heroes, new enemies!

notes.title: Patch - 0.929: Forge & Scores
notes.notes:
Hello guys,
Here is a new point for your maps: Forge.
It provides 3 options: Destroying current card, Merging current cards, and Duplicate card from the global stash of cards.
Any card that you would create - will be available for you and other adventures to be replicated.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33859050/1238f2ae4ed1831ad504a81f5985e35243c003a1.gif[/img]

There is a new language - Polish. Plz take a look - there are should be few errors - since it is the first revision. Thx!

Also, last time, I accidentally left open options for Coop and Goblin Slayer - my bad. I'm removing them for now - Coop is almost finished - should be live within next few weeks. 
Goblin Slayer is moved to be a standalone project, and maybe soon some preview will be available.
